name: How long does a typical bathroom door frame repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom door frame repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom door frame repair depends on the severity and complexity of the damage. Minor repairs, such as filling small holes or cracks, might be completed within a few hours to half a day. More extensive repairs involving cutting out rotten wood, patching with new material, and extensive sanding and painting could take a full day or sometimes two, especially if drying times for fillers or paint are required between steps. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing the specific damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs can take a few hours; extensive repairs involving rot removal and patching might take one to two days, depending on drying times.
